review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 49) consolidates Lessons 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: 1st Person Sg Future Concord (ndicha-); Mupanda 15/17 Prefix (ku-); Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 9 (i-/dzi-) Noun. Example utterances reviewed: "ndichangoziva kuti ndine nhumbu ende handisi kuziva kuti ndoita sei chekutanga kuudza muridzi wenhumbu kana kuudza amai vangu" | "mwana wangu arikuita manyoka ndiri kunetsekana kuti anogona kuzo guma a-aperezeka muviri kana ku kupera mvura mumuviri" | "sahwira vangu vakandiudza kuti screening ye cervical cancer inorwadza asi ndingada kuziva kubva kunemi mazvikokota kuti zvinofamba sei"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndichangoziva kuti ndine nhumbu ende handisi kuziva kuti ndoita sei chekutanga kuudza muridzi wenhumbu kana kuudza amai ______' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'ndichangoziva kuti ndine nhumbu ende handisi kuziva kuti ndoita sei chekutanga k')
review_exercises.explanation: 'vangu' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mwana wangu arikuita manyoka ndiri kunetsekana kuti anogona kuzo guma a-aperezeka muviri kana ku kupera mvura ______' (Parent's pediatric inquiry in Zezuru: 'mwana wangu arikuita manyoka ndiri kunetsekana kuti anogona kuzo guma a-aperezek')
review_exercises.explanation: 'mumuviri' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndukunzwa kuvaviwa .around my private parts ndingadawo kuziva kuti chii chingave chisina kumira zvakanaka chingange chakanganisika ______' (Zezuru utterance (ndukunzwa / to (infinitive) / towards [vaviwa] / around / my / private / at / on (specific point) [rts] / ndingadawo / to (infinitive) / towards [ziva]))

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndingada kuziva kuti screening ye cervical cancer yemadzimai inoitirwa kupi kunzvimbo dzakaita sedzipi dzekuti ndingawanewo ______' (Community health consultation in Zezuru: 'ndingada kuziva kuti screening ye cervical cancer yemadzimai inoitirwa kupi kunz')

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mwana wangu arikurutsa zvakanyanya ndingada kuzivawo kuti ndingamuendesa kuchipatara zvarinhi kana zvadii arikurutsa arikuramba ______' (Parent's pediatric inquiry in Zezuru: 'mwana wangu arikurutsa zvakanyanya ndingada kuzivawo kuti ndingamuendesa kuchipa')
